summary: This directory provides a set of formal strategies for reconciling conflicting data structures by defining specific rules for how values are combined, replaced, or merged during object or configuration updates.
responsibilities: Define logic for resolving value conflicts between two data sources
Implement rules for overwriting or preserving data during merge operations
Ensure consistent state transitions when applying updates to existing objects
relationships: A merge strategy determines how conflict resolution rules are applied to input data.
The override logic dictates the priority of values when a conflict occurs during the merging process.
designDecisions: Strategy pattern to encapsulate different merging behaviors
Test-driven development for verifying merge behavior accuracy
